citation: Pilis K, et al. Sci Rep 2025;15:22805
protocol: 8 days of water-only fasting (ad libitum water); blood at rest in the morning (08:00-09:30, after 12 h fast) before fasting and after day 8, plus after maximal exercise tests
population: 13 healthy middle-aged men, 57.3 +/- 9.9 y, 81.7 kg, BMI 20-29.9
note: Broadest marker set of the topic; only two time points (before, end of day 8) per condition; exercise columns are separate. Same research programme as Stec-2023 and Karol-2025 but different data.
